title: Invited teammates sign in as their own human principals with viewer or maintainer roles
description: Against a real control plane and a temporary Postgres, the operator invites a viewer and a maintainer with graphyard invite; each redeems its own link into a 90-day session; the maintainer files work attributed to them while the viewer is refused; neither answers a human-only decision; revoking the maintainer ends its session; only the operator invites.

steps.name: Invite, redeem, act and revoke as teammates
